work pieces in place when they aie being machined.

IS : 5998 - 1984 

3. Designation —A parallel sided clamp plate having of = 14 mm and / = 90 mm shall be designated 
as: 

Parallel Sided Clamp Plate 14 x 90 IS : 5998 

4. Material — Steel suitably hardened and tempered to a tensile strength of 750 to 850 N/mm^. 

5. Finish — The parallel sided clanrp plates shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 
These shall also be free from sharp corners. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anti corrosive surface treatment shall be given to parallel sided clamp plates. 

6.2 The parallel sided clamp plates shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 

7. Marking 

7.1 The parallel sided clamp plates shall be marked at an appropriate place with designation, 
manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

7.2 ISI Certification Marliing^ Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORYNOTE 

This standard was first published in 1971. The commtitee responsible for the formulation of 
this standard decided to revise it on the basis of experience gained over so many years, and to keep 
it in line with other standards on clamps, which are also being revised, with respect to materials, 
roughness values, tolerance and rationalization of sizes. 

In the present revision, certain changes in dimensions of parallel sided clamp plates for screw 
sizes M20 and M24 have been effected. One more size of clamp plates for screw size M30 has been 
included 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi, India
